The chart app has three packages that call `defineExtensionConfigSchema`. Each one registers schemas in its `startupApp()`, and the framework's `defineExtensionConfigSchema` (`openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-config/src/module-config/module-config.ts:445-460`) validates each schema, merges it with the implicit schema, and stores it under the extension name. If that behaviour changed, these registrations and the components that read their config through `useConfig` would be affected.

**Registration call sites (most direct)**
- `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-flags-app/src/index.ts:10-14` registers `patient-flags-risk-count` and `patient-flags-list`.
- `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-banner-app/src/index.ts:23-26` registers `person-attribute-tag`.
- `openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-generic-patient-widgets-app/src/index.ts:20-23` registers `obs-by-encounter-widget` and `obs-table-horizontal-widget`.
